name: 1Password Account Hygiene
description: Periodic hygiene review of a client's 1Password account for QBRs and license true-ups: reconciling active and suspended seats against the client's headcount, finding long-suspended and never-used seats, and summarising the admin changes made during the review period (who was invited, who gained or lost group and vault access, who changed account settings). Seat inventory uses read-tier tools; the change summary uses the admin-gated audit feed.
